propositions: PR #125 bundles two dependency bumps: zizmor 1.28.0→1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0; only zizmor should land, mcp 2.0 migration is deferred to ticket 732b
mcp 2.0 removes module mcp.server.fastmcp which is imported by src/rebar/mcp_server.py:570 and scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py:72, blocking the upgrade without structural migration work
Zizmor must be pinned exactly at 1.29.0 in the dev group for local-CI parity; the pin must remain exact after upgrade
uv.lock must be regenerated with 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor' and pass 'uv lock --check' validation; committed lock must match uv's output exactly

The zizmor 1.29.0 bump must pass 'make lint' on .github/workflows/release.yml without new findings; all acceptance criteria (AC1-AC6) covering pyproject, lock, lint, Gerrit merge, PR closure, and provenance comments must be verified
